responsibility_name: maintain healthy indoor air quality and address mould

evidence.evidence_text: If the air quality detector registers humidity levels greater than 60% and there are traces of mould, it purifies the air every hour and sends a message to the specialized technician.

coding.rationale: Evidence triggers air purification and technician alert when humidity >60% with mould traces, an ongoing air-quality maintenance duty against mould-related health harm.

responsibility_name: obtain timely treatment and medication when ill

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN the user is unwell IF the Smart Watch reports a body temperature above 37° SEND SMS to the doctor to get a prescription for a medicine AND contact the pharmacy to have it sent home

coding.rationale: On fever above 37C the system contacts doctor for prescription and pharmacy delivery, supporting recovery after illness onset.

evidence.evidence_text: "When the user is not in the bedroom and if the crib sensor detects a movement greater than 10cm from the bars, then activate the anti-fall net of the crib and broadcast ""crib danger!"" via Alexa"

coding.rationale: Crib sensor detecting movement >10cm triggers anti-fall net and danger broadcast, guarding infant against fall injury when unattended.

evidence.evidence_text: when the sensor detects the presence of the baby and the volume in the room reaches 80 Decibels, then move the cradle and turn on the cam.

coding.rationale: When baby presence and 80dB volume (crying) detected, cradle moves and camera activates to soothe distress and enable monitoring.

responsibility_name: Support fitness when measured health falls below threshold

evidence.evidence_text: The user weighs himself with an impedance scale, gives us an estimate of our physical health and if this is below a certain threshold, he programs a special workout by creating an agenda with time and exercise

coding.rationale: Impedance scale estimate below threshold triggers programmed workout agenda, optimizing fitness under a measured health deficit.
